name: rental
description: Analyze local 2-4 unit multifamily listings for long-term rental investment: ingest a Redfin CSV export, screen with a zero-API heuristic, enrich the shortlist with RentCast rent estimates and comps, and report cash-on-cash returns across price scenarios. Also estimates itemized rehab costs (bathroom/kitchen/roof/electrical) for the NH Seacoast market.
